data.title: Finding the Slope of a Line
data.description: Practice coordinate plane skills with Ordered pairs on the coordinate plane

challenges.instruction: Find the slope of the line passing through the points (-4, 2) and (2, 5).
challenges.hint: Use the slope formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1)

challenges.instruction: Find the slope of the line passing through the points (-3, -1) and (1, 7).
challenges.hint: Subtract the y-coordinates for the numerator and the x-coordinates for the denominator.

challenges.instruction: Find the slope of the line passing through the points (-2, 4) and (3, -1).
challenges.hint: Calculate the change in y divided by the change in x.

challenges.instruction: Find the slope of the line passing through the points (-6, 3) and (2, 3).
challenges.hint: Observe the y-values. When y does not change as x changes, what is the slope?

challenges.instruction: Find the slope of the line passing through the points (-5, -2) and (1, 1).
challenges.hint: Find the vertical rise and divide by the horizontal run.
